description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence. Join a team focused on fostering a supportive and high-quality environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while driving continuous improvement in clinical outcomes, resident satisfaction, and financial performance. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a reputable organization.

If you are a proven leader with a passion for long-term care and rehabilitation, we invite you to explore this confidential opportunity. We are looking for an individual who can inspire a team and uphold the highest standards of care.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, financial performance, and quality outcomes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually.
